description.short: Tickets, reminders, escalations and client files for the VA team.
description.full: Shadow Accountant brings the Virtual Accounting practice into Teams. It posts new client tickets, reminders when a client has been waiting for a reply during business hours, escalations for the Escalations channel and new client files. Start, close or reassign a ticket straight from the card, and ask any question about your clients in a 1:1 chat with Shadow to get an answer with sources. Admins link each Senior Accountant's channel by typing 'link <accountant email>' in it, and the Escalations channel with 'link escalations'.
